question: Which materials are enumerated as suitable for the ritual vessels?
premises: Vessels made of clay are mentioned
Vessels born of tortoise shell are mentioned
Vessels made of bell metal and copper metal are mentioned
inference: Suitable ritual vessels may be made of clay, tortoise shell, bell metal, or copper metal
plain_english: O goddess, vessels made of clay, born of tortoise, made of bell metal, and born of copper metal.
